# WRECK – Watch Reverse Engineering & Cracking Kit

> Blueprint and CLI that let humans and AI agents study and customise cheap Chinese smartwatches they own, in a
> traceable way and within the legal framework (EU: Software Directive Art. 5/6, Trade Secrets Directive Art. 3).
> Vendor material stays private.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and workflow for AI agents
- [LEGAL.md](LEGAL.md): what is allowed, what must never enter the repo
- [docs/PLAYBOOK.md](docs/PLAYBOOK.md): phases 0–6 with gates

## Knowledge
- [docs/RECOVERY.md](docs/RECOVERY.md): way back before every experiment
- [docs/CHIPS.md](docs/CHIPS.md): chip families and markers
- [docs/APP-LAYER.md](docs/APP-LAYER.md): your own app layer instead of one-off patches
- [docs/EVIDENCE.md](docs/EVIDENCE.md): status values, ledger, reports
- [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md): external tools
- [docs/formats/jl-watchface.md](docs/formats/jl-watchface.md): JieLi watch face format

## Example
- [devices/m78-jl701n/](devices/m78-jl701n/README.md): M78 with JieLi JL701N, hardware facts and lessons learned
